scenes.title: House rules, enforced
items: {fact.noDash} in anything written: code, docs, commits.
Persistent files are written to a temporary file, then atomically replaced.
Every command's output is bounded; full logs go to scratch, never the repository.
git status is a lock: no session writes over changes it does not recognise.
{fact.subNoWrite}
Every code change report ends with a Layer line naming the owning module.

scenes.sub: scripts/todo-graph.py keeps the plan honest.
lines: $ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py validate       # structure and graph integrity
$ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py plan --sync    # regenerate the plan
$ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py plan --check   # fail if the plan is stale (CI runs it)
$ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py query ready    # dependency-safe work, this lane only
$ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py query blocked  # what waits, and on what
$ python3 scripts/todo-graph.py query stats    # this lane's health
$ {fact.mergeDriver}   # merges regenerate the plan

scenes.title: What keeps the loop alive, and safe
items: Stop hook: while ready rows remain, the session may not end its turn; it lets go after {fact.stallBreaker} with no change, so a stuck loop cannot spin forever.
Heartbeat: a cron job at {fact.heartbeatCron} resumes an idle session with its full context.
Handover: a new session takes over a run with acquire --handover.
A run whose only work waits on another lane {fact.waitNotEnd}: each heartbeat merges main in and resumes the run when a row is ready.
At every section boundary: merge open pull requests on main and check CI; a red build comes first.
The guard {fact.failsOpen}: a broken guard never blocks other work.

scenes.title: The rules of a review
items: Findings are graded P1, P2 or P3; a P1 or P2 is fixed and proven by another round.
Every reply ends with an OVERALL line: approve or needs-attention.
A reviewer that fails, times out or replies {fact.blocked} is skipped and recorded: {fact.noReviewNotApproval}
Light-risk sections run one medium round of adversarial and plan-delivery lenses instead of the full set.
A low-effort round that finds a P1 earns another medium adversarial round.
The Muse Wonder final review is {fact.finalOff} since 29 Oct 20:36 SAST, {fact.finalOffWhy}; it comes back, with higher efforts where they help, {fact.finalPolish}.

scenes.sub: It refuses without its evidence.

--sha <the full 40 character implementation commit> \
{fact.stampPlanFlag} docs/reviews/01-intake/D01-T01-s1.md \
--review '1:docs/reviews/01-intake/D01-T01-s1.md:clean' \
--check '<command> -> <quoted result>'

scenes.sub: The quality bar is mechanical, not a matter of memory.

scenes.title: Hooks and checks
items: A PreToolUse hook refuses any review that is not run in the background, so the session is told the moment it finishes.
Git hooks run in every worktree: pre-commit, pre-merge-commit and pre-push.
pre-commit refuses a staged line that names a client, read from a git-ignored list.
pre-push refuses a push whose typecheck or lint would turn CI red.
check-publication.py checks the index for private data before every push to the public repository.
local-tool-safety is loaded before any outbound, destructive or account-changing operation.
CI runs {fact.ciJobs} jobs on every push: Worker gates, the Worker tests split into shards, the voice decoder against FFmpeg, the TODO graph and the script tests. It never deploys.
